name: fill-before-copy
title: Fill Before Copy
description: Turns each placeholder (<YOUR_API_KEY>, {{project_id}}) into an inline field and blocks Copy, or asks once, until all of them are filled.

meta.stops: Pasted a command with YOUR_API_KEY in it
meta.summary: Turns placeholders like <YOUR_API_KEY> in a code sample into fields and holds Copy until they're filled, so broken commands aren't pasted.
catches: Placeholders left in a command or config snippet
Which placeholder is still empty, by moving focus to it
limits: Only finds placeholders matching the pattern
Values typed into the fields are in the page; avoid pre-filling real secrets in shared docs
a11y: Each placeholder field has an aria-label from its name, with aria-invalid when asked to fill it
Copy is described by an aria-live="polite" status; blocked copy moves focus to the first empty field
